title: Textures of dimension-six operators in the SMEFT with non-invertible selection rules
summary: We investigate the flavor structures of dimension-six operators in the Standard Model Effective Field Theory (SMEFT) subject to non-invertible selection rules. In particular, we classify the flavor textures of all baryon-number-conserving dimension-six SMEFT operators and determine the resulting constraints on their Wilson coefficients. The selection rules determine not only the texture zeros but also the allowed tensor structures of the Wilson coefficients, which can be expressed analytically in terms of a reduced number of independent parameters.
